verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity is an identity-verification API service, not an AI agent or MCP host, so consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers is a category error for this kind of product. The evidence of an official Stripe MCP server (stripe-identity-docs-12, stripe-identity-probe-4) is the server role, which lets agents call Stripe. It is not client-side capability and does not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
